# Fitraat Focus

> Find a purpose: a target and the steps to reach it. Add it to Fitraat Focus and follow those steps one by one.

This site (purpose.fitraatfocus.com) is where people find a shared purpose or write one. The steps are done in the Fitraat Focus app, on a phone or on the web.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://purpose.fitraatfocus.com/): What a purpose is, how following one works, and common questions.
- [Shared purposes](https://purpose.fitraatfocus.com/systems): Public purposes, each with a target and ordered steps.
- [A purpose](https://purpose.fitraatfocus.com/systems/{id}): The target, who wrote it, the sections, and the todos.
- [A creator](https://purpose.fitraatfocus.com/creators/{id}): Who wrote the steps, and the purposes they have shared.

## Private

- /dashboard and /auth are the creator studio and sign-in. They are not public content.

## Product

- [Web app](https://app.fitraatfocus.com/welcome)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fitraatfocus)
